'''2002 Origins Open''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament at Origins 2002 (4–7 July 2002) in Columbus, Ohio. [[Ken Cross]] finished 7th in the open with a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] list (''Squires Origins Profit'', 3–0 as posted).<ref name="dt-24668">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24668 Squires Origins Profit], DeckTech (Ken "Squires" Cross, 29 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24668/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24668/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009042401/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24668/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="origins-2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020802004658/http://www.decipher.com/conventions/2002/origins.html Origins 2002], decipher.com (Wayback, 2 August 2002)</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 4–7 July 2002
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
